description_en: Queries a list of cache refresh plans
description_zh: 获取缓存刷新套餐包列表
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-isp-flush-cache-instances --lang example-string --page-number 1 --page-size 1 --keyword example-string --isp example-string --type example-string --order-by example-string --direction example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeIspFlushCacheInstances

parameters.help_en: The language of the returned information. Valid values: zh for Chinese and en for English
parameters.help_zh: 返回信息的语言，zh 为中文，en 为英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from 1
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的页码，从 1 开始
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The keyword used to query by instance ID or name
parameters.help_zh: 按实例 ID 或名称查询时使用的关键词
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The Internet service provider (ISP) to filter by. Valid values: TELECOM
parameters.help_zh: 要筛选的运营商，当前支持 TELECOM（电信）
parameters.name: isp

parameters.help_en: The keyword type. Valid values: INSTANCE_ID for instance ID and INSTANCE_NAME for instance name
parameters.help_zh: 关键词类型，INSTANCE_ID 表示实例 ID，INSTANCE_NAME 表示实例名称
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The field used to sort the instance list. Valid values: EXPIRE_DATE
parameters.help_zh: 实例列表排序字段，目前支持 EXPIRE_DATE（到期时间）
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The sort order. Valid values: ASC for ascending order and DESC for descending order
parameters.help_zh: 排序方向：ASC 为升序，DESC 为降序
parameters.name: direction

IspFlushCacheInstances.description_en: The ISP cache refresh instances that match the query conditions
IspFlushCacheInstances.description_zh: 符合条件的运营商缓存刷新实例列表

items.description_en: The details of an ISP cache refresh instance
items.description_zh: 单个运营商缓存刷新实例的信息

ExpireTime.description_en: The time when the instance expires. The time is in UTC and follows the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format
ExpireTime.description_zh: 实例到期时间，使用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ

ExpireTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp in milliseconds when the instance expires
ExpireTimestamp.description_zh: 实例到期时间的毫秒时间戳

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the cache refresh instance

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the cache refresh instance

Isp.description_en: The ISP to which the instance belongs. Valid values: TELECOM
Isp.description_zh: 实例所属运营商，TELECOM 表示电信

QuotaInfo.description_en: The cache refresh quota information for the instance
QuotaInfo.description_zh: 实例的缓存刷新额度信息

InstanceQuota.description_en: The total cache refresh quota available to the instance
InstanceQuota.description_zh: 实例可用的缓存刷新总额度

InstanceQuotaUsed.description_en: The used cache refresh quota of the instance
InstanceQuotaUsed.description_zh: 实例已经使用的缓存刷新额度

Status.description_en: The instance status. Valid values: NORMAL for normal, EXHAUSTED for quota exhausted, and EXPIRED for expired
Status.description_zh: 实例状态：NORMAL 为正常，EXHAUSTED 为额度用尽，EXPIRED 为已过期

VersionCode.description_en: The version code of the plan associated with the instance
VersionCode.description_zh: 实例对应的套餐版本编码

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 当前返回结果的每页记录数

TotalItems.description_en: The total number of entries that match the query conditions

TotalPages.description_en: The total number of pages that match the query conditions
